title: Cumbia Basics (Part 1) - 5 Ways to Improve Instantly in 2018 | How 2 Dance

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor breaks down steps systematically, showing both solo and partner variations from the front and back. He pairs verbal explanations with counting and demonstration to guide learners.

lesson_structure.note: Meli introduces the Cumbia basics video.
Montage of dancers doing cumbia steps.
Instructor introduces and breaks down the Cumbia basic step.
Instructor introduces and breaks down the Side to Side basic step.
Instructor demonstrates combining the steps with a partner.
Dancing the cumbia steps to music.

cues: push your body back to center

steps_taught.name: Cumbia Basic Step
steps_taught.description: Rock back and step in place with quick-quick-slow rhythm.

steps_taught.name: Side to Side Basic Step
steps_taught.description: Step side to side accenting beats 5 and 7.

what_works: Clear counting and demonstration from the back view making it easy to follow along.

quotes.text: the first cumbia step we're going to go into our basic
if we're using our counts our counts again are going to be the same as salsa

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor demonstrates basic cumbia steps facing forward with quick-quick-slow rhythm
Instructor turns to face the back while explaining footwork starting with the left leg
Counting out loud 1-2-3 5-6-7 while stepping back

extraction.distinctive_method: Turning around to face away from the camera so students can follow footwork directly without mirror reversal.
